Street markets are common in many cities around the world. Vendors arrive early in the morning to set up their tables, and shoppers come to buy fresh fruit, vegetables and bread at low prices.

Many shoppers like to talk with the vendors. They ask about the food and sometimes ask for a lower price.

Ana Lopez wrote this story for VOA Learning English.
